title: Creamy Palm Panna Cotta with Peruvian Wine Sauce
description: A creamy dessert with a Peruvian twist, featuring a wine-infused sauce.

ingredients.name: Palm cream
ingredients.notes: Heavy cream can be used as a substitute

ingredients.name: Peruvian wine
ingredients.notes: Red or white wine can be used

instructions: Combine palm cream, sugar, and Brasil form in a saucepan. Heat over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Strain the mixture into individual serving cups.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, drizzle with Peruvian wine sauce (see below).
Peruvian wine sauce: Combine Peruvian wine, Nam, and Tan pip in a saucepan. Bring to a simmer and cook until reduced by half.
Serve chilled, garnished with fresh fruit or nuts if desired.
